changes: Fixed missing patched conics UI drawing that I accidentally removed when removing DynamicCelestial class yesterday.
Stopped ImGui from eating the mouse when the mouse is supposed to be hidden.

Fixed out of range issue when the player goes crazy and starts creating maneuvers and hitting escape over and over which ends up with empty maneuver flight plans, that wasn't being catered for. I know, I should have thought of this edge case, but you live and learn.

Added first pass of extensions and improvements to gauge system. Much more debugging options, and SDF resolution hooks. Working towards including Relative Velocity as a digit roller, with a unit specification.
Fixed Gemini did not include gauge canvases.
Found the actual no mouse flag for ImGui
Added Sdf sharpness game setting, this value applies an offset to the sdf normalized resolution value, to produce sharper or blurier sdf elements used in the gauge system.
Added Velocity gauge that shows the velocity in the current frame of reference.

Added support for packed normalized unit gauge digits. These kinds of digit references will alter their roller digit reference values based on an appropriate unit order of magnitude, implemented for the Altitude and Velocity gauge rollers.
Add atmospheres to Uranus and Neptune
Tweak atmospheres for Venus, Titan and Saturn
Serialize physical atmosphere settings when exporting from atmosphere UI
Fix frameNumber not getting incremented for clouds and other effects that need it
Swapped the maneuvering UI to use newer gizmos.
